sections.text: Made slowly, by hand Everything starts the night before. Here's what you'll find on the counter. Sourdough Our country l
sections.words: Made slowly, by hand Everything starts the night before. Here's what you'll find on the counter. Sourdough Our country loaf rises for 36 hours. Crackling crust, open crumb, a gentle tang. Pastries Croissants, cardamom buns and seasonal danishes, laminated with Scottish butter. Tea & coffee Loose-leaf tea from a family blender in Perth and coffee roasted down the road.

sections.text: A bakery that started in a flat kitchen Mairi baked her first loaves for neighbours during a long winter. The queue at h
sections.words: A bakery that started in a flat kitchen Mairi baked her first loaves for neighbours during a long winter. The queue at her door grew until it needed a shop of its own. Today a team of six bakes through the night so the windows are full by seven. We still know most of our regulars by name — and their order. — Mairi & the Crumb team
